text.EN: It's dead. I really hate this.
Down. God, the smell makes me sick.
text.TL: Bagsak. Diyos ko, nasusuka ako sa amoy.

text.EN: It's finished. I despise having to do that.
text.TL: Tapos na. Ayaw na ayaw kong kailangang gawin 'yon.

text.EN: Dead. Look at all that blood... horrible.
text.TL: Patay na. Tingnan mo ang dugo... kakila-kilabot.

text.EN: Got it down. Hate everything about this.
text.TL: Naibagsak ko na. Kinamumuhian ko ang lahat ng ito.

text.EN: It's dead. Why does it always have to be like this?
text.TL: Patay na. Bakit kailangang laging ganito?

text.EN: Down. I hate the crunch it made.
text.TL: Bagsak. Ayaw ko 'yung naging lagutok no'n.

text.EN: It's over. Sick of the violence.
text.TL: Tapos na. Sawa na ako sa karahasan.

text.EN: Dead. I really, really hate this world.
text.TL: Patay. Ayoko talaga, ayoko sa mundong 'to.

text.EN: Killed it. Hate the feeling in my hands.
text.TL: Napatay ko na. Ayoko 'yung pakiramdam sa mga kamay ko.
